title: I’ve never felt a room as excited for anything as it felt to be at @T...
transcript: Join me to attend The Jimmy Awards this is the first time I've ever gone to The Jimmys I am so excited! If you don't know The Jimmy Awards are the high school musical theater awards. There are a lot of Broadway folks that come out of The Jimmys like Eva Noblezada and Ryan McCarten Andrew Barth Feldman. Renee Rapp! This is the 15th annual Jimmy Awards. There are 102 nominees that were chosen out of over 100,000 high school students from across the country. They’ve been here all week doing like master classes and events and trainings and then tonight is the actual ceremony. My friend Rebecca is Jimmys photographer I'm her plus one so let's go find her and go to the show. It’s intermission.They're so good Everyone’s so talented. I've cried like four times. I just cried for like 30 minutes straight Insane. Truly ridiculous. but thank you it was the best night ever and I know people say you know “We see the future of Broadway” but like literally all those children are going to Broadway. Every single one of them. We’re at the after party Rebecca's doing all the photos I'm just hanging One. Two. Three. You’re at The Jimmys! Honestly thisparty's pretty lit for high school party. Obviously had to get donuts to go The was so fun.That was like the best night ever. I love The Jimmy Awards. I also met a lot of you at the party and it was so fun thank you for saying hi Congratulations to everyone!
